title: The Crown's Call
summary: Placing the Crown of the Sovereign upon his head, Ha-Jun is pulled into an ethereal mindscape duel against the ancient consciousness of First Sovereign Asmodaius.

panels.shot: golden-violet mana column erupting from summit wide shot
panels.action: A ten-mile-wide column of celestial mana roars into the cosmos from Mount Obsidian's peak.
panels.prose_en: A ten-mile-wide column of celestial mana roars into the cosmos from Mount Obsidian's peak.
panels.prose_hi: Mount obsidian ki choti se akashiya man ka das meal chauda stambh brahmand mein garjana karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes rolling back as reality dissolves
panels.action: Ha-Jun sits on the throne; his irises flood with pure white light as his consciousness is ripped inward.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits on the throne; his irises flood with pure white light as his consciousness is ripped inward.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sinhasan par baithta hai; jaise hi uski chetna andar ki or fatati hai, uski putli shuddh safed roshni se bhar jaati hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun reaching out in panic
panels.action: Tae-Jun rushes up the steps: 'Ha-Jun! Crown ko resist karo! Apne dimaag ko chhodna mat!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: HA-JUN!! APNA MIND CONTROL MAT KHONA!!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun rushes up the steps: 'Ha-Jun! Crown ko resist karo! Apne dimaag ko chhodna mat!'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun teji se sidhiyan chadhta hai: 'Ha-Jun! crown ko virodh karo! apne dimag ko chhodana mat!'.

panels.shot: mindscape chamber: the hall of black mirrors
panels.action: Ha-Jun finds himself standing on an endless sea of black glass under a sky of swirling red nebulas.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun finds himself standing on an endless sea of black glass under a sky of swirling red nebulas.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun khud ko ghumte hue lal neeharikaon ke aakash ke neeche kale kaanch ke antaheen samudra par khada pata hai.

panels.shot: titanic 100-foot shadowy emperor looming overhead
panels.action: Sitting on an ethereal throne of swords: the colossal shadow of the First Sovereign, Lord Asmodaius.
panels.prose_en: Sitting on an ethereal throne of swords: the colossal shadow of the First Sovereign, Lord Asmodaius.
panels.prose_hi: Talwaron ke ek alaukik sinhasan par baithe: pratham samprabhu, lord asamodius ki vishal chhaya.

panels.shot: asmodaius glowing four crimson eyes looking down
panels.action: Four burning crimson eyes glare down like dying stars: 'A fragile human vessel dares put my crown upon his head?!'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: TUM SIRF MERI WAAPSI KA VESSEL HO! APNI BODY MUJHE SURRENDER KARO!

panels.prose_en: Four burning crimson eyes glare down like dying stars: 'A fragile human vessel dares put my crown upon his head?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Char jalti hui lal aankhen marte hue sitaron ki tarah chamak rahi han: 'ek najuk manav jahaj mera mukut apne sir par rakhne ki himmat kar raha hai?'.

panels.shot: black shadow tendrils wrapping around ha-jun legs
panels.action: Dark shadow tendrils erupt from the glass floor, creeping up Ha-Jun's jeans and jacket like liquid tar.
panels.prose_en: Dark shadow tendrils erupt from the glass floor, creeping up Ha-Jun's jeans and jacket like liquid tar.
panels.prose_hi: Kanch ke farsh se kali chhaya ki tendrils footati han, jo Ha-Jun ki jeans aur jacket par taral tar ki tarah rengti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun struggling against the mental possession
panels.action: Ha-Jun grits his teeth; his temples throb with veins as ancient memories flood his cortex.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh meri memories ko erase karne ki koshish kar raha hai... Mera naam, mera bachpan!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grits his teeth; his temples throb with veins as ancient memories flood his cortex.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne dant pista hai; uski kanpati ki nasen dhadak rahi hain kyonki prachin smritiyan uske valkut mein vyapt han.

panels.shot: memories of school bullying flashing in fragments
panels.action: Shards of memory: bullies kicking him in the classroom, rain on the academy roof, feeling helpless.
panels.prose_en: Shards of memory: bullies kicking him in the classroom, rain on the academy roof, feeling helpless.
panels.prose_hi: Smriti ke tukde: dabangon ne use kaksha mein laat mari, akadami ki chhat par baarish hui, asahaay mahsoos hua.

panels.shot: asmodaius mocking ha-jun past weakness
panels.action: Asmodaius booms: 'See how weak you were! A cowering insect beaten by mortal children!'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Tum kamzor the, aur hamesha kamzor rahoge! Let a real God rule!

panels.prose_en: Asmodaius booms: 'See how weak you were! A cowering insect beaten by mortal children!'.
panels.prose_hi: Esmodius chillata hai: 'dekho tum kitne kamzor the! nashwar bachchon dwara peeta gaya ek darpok kit!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun remembering his brother's smile
panels.action: In the center of the dark glass, a golden memory shines: Kang Tae-Jun holding umbrella over 10yo Ha-Jun in the rain.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Nahi... Main kamzor tha, lekin main akela nahi tha. Mere bhai ne mere liye apni zindagi di.

panels.prose_en: In the center of the dark glass, a golden memory shines: Kang Tae-Jun holding umbrella over 10-year-old Ha-Jun in the rain.
panels.prose_hi: Kale kaanch ke kendra men, ek sunhari smriti chamakti hai: kang Tae-Jun baarish mein Dus saal ka chhota Ha-Jun ke upar chhata pakde hue hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun clenching fists in the mindscape
panels.action: Ha-Jun plants his boots firmly on the glass; a shockwave of his own crimson-violet mana blasts outward.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun plants his boots firmly on the glass; a shockwave of his own crimson-violet mana blasts outward.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne jute sheeshe par majbuti se rakhe; uske apne lal-bangni man ki ek aaghat tarang bahar ki or footati hai.

panels.shot: shadow tendrils shattering into glass fragments
panels.action: The dark possession tendrils around his legs snap and shatter like brittle ice.
panels.prose_en: The dark possession tendrils around his legs snap and shatter like brittle ice.
panels.prose_hi: Uske pairon ke charon or ka kala kabza tendril toot jata hai aur bhangur barf ki tarah bikhar jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting the sanguine fang in his mental grip
panels.action: Ha-Jun draws The Sanguine Fang, blazing with violet hellfire inside his own soul plane.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun draws The Sanguine Fang, blazing with violet hellfire inside his own soul plane.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne senguin feng ka chitran kiya hai, jo uski aatma ke bhitar baingani narkankaal se dhadhak raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up fearlessly at 100-foot emperor
panels.action: A 17-year-old high school student staring down a 100-foot primordial demon god without blinking.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum hazaaron saal pehle mar chuke ho, Asmodaius. Yeh era mera hai.

panels.prose_en: A 17-year-old high school student staring down a 100-foot primordial demon god without blinking.
panels.prose_hi: Ek 17 saal ka high school chhatra bina palak jhapkae 100 foot ke aadim rakshas devta ko ghoor raha hai.

panels.shot: asmodaius roaring in insulted fury
panels.action: The giant phantom emperor raises a 50-foot blade of shadow darkness to crush Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_en: The giant phantom emperor raises a 50-foot blade of shadow darkness to crush Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal pret samrat Ha-Jun ko kuchalne ke liye chhaya andhere ka 50 foot ka blade uthata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping 100 feet straight up in the mindscape
panels.action: Ha-Jun rockets upward, his shadow wings leaving a contrail of violet starlight through the nebulas.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rockets upward, his shadow wings leaving a contrail of violet starlight through the nebulas.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun upar ki or rocket karta hai, uski parchhai pankh niharikaon ke madhyam se baingani taron ki roshni chodti hai.

panels.shot: asmodaius shadow blade slamming down
panels.action: The giant blade smashes the glass floor beneath Ha-Jun, sending infinite mirror shards into the sky.
panels.prose_en: The giant blade smashes the glass floor beneath Ha-Jun, sending infinite mirror shards into the sky.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal blade Ha-Jun ke neeche ke kaanch ke farsh ko tod deta hai, jisse darpan ke anant tukde aakash mein fail jaate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun running up the length of asmodaius blade
panels.action: Ha-Jun sprints directly up the flat of the giant descending sword, moving at Mach 2.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sprints directly up the flat of the giant descending sword, moving at Mach 2.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun much 2 ki gati se chalte hue sidhe vishal utarti hui talwar ke flat tak daudta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun reaching asmodaius forehead crown
panels.action: Ha-Jun arrives at the giant shadow's brow, right before the phantom crown of horns.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun arrives at the giant shadow's brow, right before the phantom crown of horns.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun seengon ke pret mukut ke theek pahle, vishal chhaya ki bhaunh par pahunchta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun driving the sanguine fang into the phantom crown
panels.action: Ha-Jun plunges his flaming blood katana straight into the center of Asmodaius's forehead.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN VESSEL NAHI HOON! MAIN SOVEREIGN HOON!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun plunges his flaming blood katana straight into the center of Asmodaius's forehead.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apna dhadhkta hua khoon katana sidhe esmodius ke mathe ke kendra mein dala.

panels.shot: asmodaius colossal form cracking with golden light
panels.action: Spiderweb fractures of blinding golden light spread across the 100-foot titan's body.
panels.prose_en: Spiderweb fractures of blinding golden light spread across the 100-foot titan's body.
panels.prose_hi: 100 foot ke titan ke shareer par chakachaundh kar dene wali sunhari roshni ke makdi ke jale ke fracture fail gaye.

panels.shot: asmodaius voice shifting from wrath to stunned awe
panels.action: The primordial voice echoes with profound reverence: 'Unbending will... You truly surpass me, boy.'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Tum sach mein mere throne ke laayak ho... Rule wisely, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: The primordial voice echoes with profound reverence: 'Unbending will... You truly surpass me, boy.'.
panels.prose_hi: Maulik awaz gahri shraddha ke saath goonjati hai: 'atal ichashakti... tum sachmuch mujhse aage nikal jaoge, ladke.'

panels.shot: asmodaius dissolving into pure golden mana shower
panels.action: The giant dissolves into millions of golden star-particles, washing into Ha-Jun's soul like liquid gold.
panels.prose_en: The giant dissolves into millions of golden star-particles, washing into Ha-Jun's soul like liquid gold.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal lakhon swarn taara-kanon mein vilin ho jata hai, taral sone ki tarah Ha-Jun ki aatma mein sama jata hai.

panels.shot: mindscape dissolving back into the physical throne room
panels.action: The starry nebulas fade; the physical summit of Mount Obsidian crystallizes back into view.
panels.prose_en: The starry nebulas fade; the physical summit of Mount Obsidian crystallizes back into view.
panels.prose_hi: Taaron se bhari neeharikaen fiki pad jaati han; mount obsidian ka bhautik shikhar wapas drishya mein cristlikrit ho jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun opening eyes with full sovereign majesty
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes open: royal violet irises circled by double crimson eclipse rings and swirling stars.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes open: royal violet irises circled by double crimson eclipse rings and swirling stars.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen khulin: shahi baingani rang ki putli, dohre lal grahan chhallon aur ghumte taron se ghiri hui.

panels.shot: the crown of the sovereign settling perfectly on his brow
panels.action: The obsidian-and-ruby crown glows with peaceful, subservient violet luminescence atop his black hair.
panels.prose_en: The obsidian-and-ruby crown glows with peaceful, subservient violet luminescence atop his black hair.
panels.prose_hi: Obseedian-aur-rubi mukut uske kale baalon ke upar shantipurn, adheen baingani chamak ke saath chamakta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun kneeling on the throne steps in tears of relief
panels.action: Tae-Jun drops to his knees on the marble steps, exhaling a choked sob: 'Usne kar dikhaya... He conquered the Crown!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... Tumne Asmodaius ko subjugate kar liya!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun drops to his knees on the marble steps, exhaling a choked sob: 'Usne kar dikhaya... He conquered the Crown!'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun sangmarmar ki sidhiyon par apne ghutnon ke bal baith jata hai aur ek dabi hui saans chhodta hai: 'usne kar dikhaya... usne taj jeet liya!'

panels.shot: kuro bowing deeply on the throne armrest
panels.action: Kuro presses his forehead to the black star-matter armrest: 'Hail Ha-Jun Kang. True Demon Sovereign of the Abyss.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro presses his forehead to the black star-matter armrest: 'Hail Ha-Jun Kang. True Demon Sovereign of the Abyss.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apna matha black star-mater armerest par dabaya: 'jay Ha-Jun cong. rasatal ka sachcha danav samprabhu.'

panels.shot: ha-jun standing from the throne, sovereign domain expanding
panels.action: Ha-Jun rises; a 500-meter spherical domain of royal violet mana expands outward around Mount Obsidian.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: This realm belongs to me now.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rises; a 500-meter spherical domain of royal violet mana expands outward around Mount Obsidian.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ugta hai; royal violet maina ka 500 meter ka golakar domain mount obsidian ke charon or bahar ki or faila hua hai.
